descriptions.cc42b_sort_dispatch_802025dc: Stably bubble-sorts observed 12-byte callback records by descending signed priority, dispatches all entries with their opaque 32-bit contexts and this owner, then clears the live range and returns zero. Callback iteration captures the end before calls; clear reloads the live endpoints after callbacks. Partial C++ range and record layouts; no whole owner-size or data ownership claim.
